description: The 「usage page ↗」 link of the usage slot — narrows opener:allow-open-url to two addresses only (the Claude and Codex usage settings pages) (TRD S21 usage-limit-slot §1-7). The windows are main and pop-outs (slot-popup-*) — those two are the only windows that hold a slot. The list of the two addresses lives in this file only (default.json and popup.json carry no separate opener permission).
